description: Search hotels and resorts in a destination (city, region or resort area) with LIVE prices for the dates and party. Prices are totals for the whole stay in USD, taxes and fees included. Returns up to 15 hotels (cheapest first, or best-rated with sort=rating), with ids for get_hotel.

min_stars.description: Only hotels with at least this star rating

rooms.description: Number of rooms; adults/children are split across them

sort.description: price = cheapest first; rating = best guest rating first

name: search_hotels
